The '''Nikato's Bootheel''' was an independent pocket state based on the planet [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] which was established in [[14,300 BBY]] following the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]]. The [[Machinists of Nikato]] had [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Third Alsakan Conflict)|defeated]] the [[Duros Red Credit Brigade]] in that conflict and constructed a network of clockwork mechanisms around the ancient [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] structures.
